caption: Paired 95% homology-group bootstrap intervals on the complete 32-protein pilot. The same proteins are used on both hardware/runtime phases; they are not independent biological cohorts. Powers 2, 4, 8 were fixed after observing the power-1 validation result, before computing these comparisons. All variants reuse identical generated pools and reader outputs within each runtime. Intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons; no test metrics are used.
